{{Quote|Welcome aboard this Kuat Drive Yards D5-Mantis Patrol Craft. Its speed and firepower are unmatched by other vessels of its class.|[[2V-R8 (Hunter)|2V-R8]]|<ref name="TOR:JR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Joy Ride|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
The '''''D5-Mantis'' Patrol Craft''' was a rare, top-of-the-line [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was meant to meet the demands of larger [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|One]] was used by the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|I know one that belongs to one of them so-called "importer" types. Fast, smooth and roomy.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:JR" />}}
Built for [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]], the rare, compact-framed ''D5-Mantis'' was a best-in-class [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol craft]], designed to compete with&mdash;and meet the demands of&mdash;much larger [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruisers]].

The vessel utilized three retractable armament [[S-foils/Legends|foils]] with independent power supplies, allowing it to safely use weapons meant for larger vessels. The foils also significantly reduced the ship's profile, allowing it to land or dock in more confining spaces than other ships would be able to use. A surprising number of ''D5-Mantis'' patrol craft could, therefore, be tightly packed into [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] ships presenting a nasty surprise to enemy vessels.

The ''D5-Mantis'' engineers also made extensive use of a vertically economical interior design to condense and fully utilize space. The vessel's small bulkheads accommodated large, open areas and improved the ease of maintenance.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:D5-Mantis_interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Interior schematic of the ''D5-Mantis'', showing vertical usage of space.]]
[[File:D5-Mantis_schematic.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''D5-Mantis{{'s}}'' retractable weapons pods with independent power supplies.]]
The ''D5-Mantis'' Patrol Craft was created as the bounty hunter's class starship for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was first mentioned in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', where it was mistakenly referred to as a "Kuat D7".
